lede: Every piece of this room is built as a GLB, placed in the live Home Assistant house, then screenshotted from the exact spot the photo was taken. A separate critic with fresh context puts the two side by side and says whether ours would pass for the photo. If it would not, it goes back to the builder.

pieces.name: Vaulted ceiling
pieces.note: Shape is right and it now covers the doorway you stand in. Pitch is still wrong — our gable is a steep symmetric triangle; the photo's apex sits left of centre with two unequal slopes.

pieces.name: Bed
pieces.note: Too big and too tall. The photo has a slim mattress on a low frame with one shallow drawer, not two deep drawer fronts under a slab.

pieces.name: Wall art
pieces.note: The painting itself is close. It is scaled far too large — ours nearly reaches the vault where the photo leaves white wall all around.

pieces.name: Rug
pieces.note: Too big, too white, and the stripes read as corrugated board instead of a soft looped pile.

pieces.name: Dresser and mirror
pieces.note: The mirror renders as a dark switched-off TV rather than a bright reflective pane, and the dresser crowds the bed.

pieces.name: Baseboards
pieces.note: Not built yet. Their absence is one of the clearest giveaways in the render.

pieces.name: Windows and blinds
pieces.note: Three windows with white slatted blinds and bright panes, sized and placed off the photo.

pieces.name: Desk and chair
pieces.note: White panel-end desk under the east window; black mesh task chair turned 20° off square, as the photo shows.

pieces.name: Ceiling fan
pieces.note: Five white blades and a light kit, downrod length derived from the vault height above it.

pieces.name: Foreground chest
pieces.note: The dark chest cropped at the right edge of the photo.

pieces.name: Floor and walls
pieces.note: Grey plank floor, warm white walls. Plank repeat halved to 2.2 ft so boards read at ~6.5 in like real LVP rather than 1 ft barn boards.

footer: The floor plan was re-traced to the photo's real proportions on your call; the freed strip west of the bedroom is now a placeholder room called Master Closet.
